description:
The surah that mentions **The [Great] Tiding** of the coming of the Day og Judgment, the truth of which people yet dispute. It takes its name from the expression "the great tiding" (al-nabaʾ al-ʿaẓīm). The disbelievers often asked incredulously about the Resurrection. This surah gives evidence of God's power, then explains what will happen on the Day of Resurrection, and the respective fates of believers and disbelievers.
The surah is also known as The Announcement, The Great News, The Important News, The News

translations.1: What is it about which they question each other?!
translations.3: the one about which they differ?
translations.4: No indeed! They will soon know!
translations.5: Again, no indeed! They will soon know!
translations.6: Did We not make the earth a resting place?
translations.9: and make your sleep for rest?
translations.10: and make the night a covering?
translations.11: and make the day for livelihood?
translations.12: and build above you the seven mighty heavens?
translations.13: and make [the sun for] a radiant lamp?
translations.14: and send down water pouring from the rain-clouds,
translations.15: that with it We may bring forth grains and plants,
translations.17: Indeed the Day of Judgement is the tryst,
translations.18:
the day the Trumpet will be blown,
  and you will come in groups,
translations.19:
and the sky will be opened
   and become gates,
translations.20:
and the mountains will be set moving
   and become a mirage.
translations.24: tasting in it neither any coolness nor drink,
translations.27: Indeed they did not expect any reckoning,
translations.28: and they denied Our signs mendaciously,
translations.29: and We have figured everything in a Book.
translations.30:
So [now] taste!
 We shall increase you in nothing but punishment!
translations.31: Indeed a triumph awaits the Godwary:
translations.33: and buxom maidens of a like age,
translations.35: Therein they shall hear neither vain talk nor lies
translations.36:
—a reward from _your_ Lord,
   a bounty sufficing,<{["F", 1]}>
translations.37:
the Lord of the heavens and the earth
   and whatever is between them,
  the All-beneficent,
   whom they will not be able to address
translations.38:
on the day
     when the Spirit and the angels stand
      in an array.
   None shall speak
   except whom the All-beneficent permits
   and who says what is right.
translations.39:
That is the day of truth.
 So let anyone who wishes take resort with his Lord.
translations.40:
Indeed We have warned you
    of a punishment near at hand
   —the day when a person will observe<{["F", 1]}>
    what his hands have sent ahead
   and the faithless one will say,
   'I wish I were dust!'
